effects." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="52" y="195" width="438" height="30" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-10-badge" value="10" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#232F3E;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="277" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-10" value="For a succeeded payment that names its subscription, the worker starts <b>wf_subscription_grant_access</b> through its live alias with a business contract." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="52" y="279" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-11-badge" value="11" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#232F3E;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="321" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-11" value="The workflow runs its <i>grant_access</i> step, which Lambda checkpoints and retries; the repository grants access as a placeholder." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="52" y="323" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="legend-processing" value="<b>PROCESSING</b><font color="#545B64"> · asynchronous · triggered by SQS</font>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="16" width="470" height="18" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-5-badge" value="5" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#232F3E;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="46" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-5" value="SQS delivers batches of up to 10 to <b>webhook_worker</b>; grouping by subject keeps each subject's events in receipt order." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="48" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-6-badge" value="6" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#232F3E;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="90" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-6" value="The worker validates provider + event ID, then loads the original stored event." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="92" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-7-badge" value="7" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#232F3E;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="134" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-7" value="The worker finds the adapter in the shared registry and awaits its <i>process(event)</i>, which only logs." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="136" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-8-badge" value="8" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#232F3E;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="178" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-8" value="A message that can never succeed, such as an invalid one, is parked in the dead-letter queue at once, in its message group." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="180" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-9-badge" value="9" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#232F3E;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="222" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-9" value="A temporary failure stays in its group and is retried after the visibility timeout; after 5 receives, SQS moves it to the dead-letter queue." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="224" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="legend-state" value="<b>STATE</b><font color="#545B64"> · durable data</font><font color="#545B64"> · gray, dashed parts are planned</font>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="276" width="470" height="18" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-12-badge" value="12" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#879196;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="306" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-12" value="<i>Planned:</i> the table's stream sends a new image of every changed event, attempt, delivery, and effect to <b>webhook_history_projector</b>." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="308" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-13-badge" value="13" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#879196;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="350" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-13" value="<i>Planned:</i> the projector adds each image to the <i>history</i> schema of the <b>platform</b> database as <b>history_writer</b>, which can add history but never delete it." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="352" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-14-badge" value="14" style="ellipse;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#879196;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="510" y="394" width="22" height="22" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="step-14" value="<i>Planned:</i> business effects read and change their own schemas through repositories, such as <b>SqlSubscriptionRepository</b> for subscriptions." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=0;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="542" y="396" width="438" height="30" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="hazards" value="<b>Delivery hazards handled</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Forged requests <font color="#545B64">→ rejected</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Duplicate deliveries <font color="#545B64">→ stored once</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Retries after slow acks <font color="#545B64">→ 200 quickly</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Events out of order <font color="#545B64">→ flagged outdated</font></font>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=10;spacingTop=8;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D5DBDB;rounded=1;arcSize=4;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="20.0" y="448" width="309.3333333333333" height="128" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="workflow-failures" value="<b>Failures handled</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Step fails <font color="#545B64">→ retried for 2 to 4 hours</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Repeated start <font color="#545B64">→ same execution, 14 days</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Deploy mid-run <font color="#545B64">→ resumes on its version</font></font>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=10;spacingTop=8;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D5DBDB;rounded=1;arcSize=4;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="345.3333333333333" y="448" width="309.3333333333333" height="128" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="database-notes" value="<b>Platform database</b><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Schemas <font color="#545B64">→ one per concern, own writer role</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Network <font color="#545B64">→ reached only by database clients</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Idle 5 minutes <font color="#545B64">→ paused, storage cost only</font></font><br><font style="font-size:11px">• Delete <font color="#545B64">→ blocked · 7-day backups</font></font>" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontColor=#232F3E;spacing=10;spacingTop=8;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D5DBDB;rounded=1;arcSize=4;" parent="legend" vertex="1"><mxGeometry x="670.6666666666666" y="448" width="309.3333333333333" height="128" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

text.tspan: Delivery hazards handled
• Forged requests → rejected
• Duplicate deliveries → stored once
• Retries after slow acks → 200 quickly
• Events out of order → flagged outdated

• Idle 5 minutes → paused, storage cost only
• Delete → blocked · 7-day backups
